name: chart-area
title: Area Chart
description: Three small analytics cards each holding an area chart of visitor numbers. Gradient and stacked fills sit beside a stepped version, and hovering a chart shows a tooltip.
use: A dashboard needs several small area charts that stay readable in compact cards.
avoid: The cards carry fixed demo data and English copy, so each variant needs its data and labels replaced.
a11y: Charts use an accessibility layer with names, but the tooltip data is not reachable without a pointer. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three bordered dark cards sit side by side, each with a title, a grey area chart on faint horizontal gridlines and a small footer stat. Chart shapes differ: smooth filled humps, a two-tone stack and a blocky step line.
behaves: Hovering over a chart reveals a small tooltip listing the month and values. The legend card's entries use dots, and the step chart holds each value flat before jumping.
customise: Data arrays, chart configs and titles are written per variant in the source; swapping datasets means editing the file.
weight: light: Three small SVG charts with six points each; no animation loop.
